output.summary: A perennial native to the Americas, Indian shot has edible, starch-rich rhizomes and exceptionally hard black seeds resembling shotgun pellets. In part of Peru, the rhizomes were traditionally wrapped in leaves and slowly baked underground for the Festival of Corpus Christi.
output.edibilityNote: The starch-rich rhizomes are edible; in part of Peru they were traditionally slow-baked underground for the Festival of Corpus Christi.
